title: Text API tracking repaired
summary:
Text API tracking got a repair, the GitHub assistant changed hands, and the architecture diagram caught up with model routing.

Text generation success and error events were brought into line with image API analytics. The same PR raised the text API limit from 20 to 40 requests per minute and added localhost and pollinations.github.io to its allowed domains.

The GitHub resolver switched from OpenHands to MentatBot, using labeled issues and pull requests rather than comment and review triggers. The README and homepage references were updated, with the homepage using the simpler name “AI assistant.”

The README architecture diagram now shows Mistral, Qwen, and Llama connected through Scaleway and Deepseek models through the Deepseek API, rather than placing Mistral and Llama under Azure.
